traits.flower_symmetry.note: Abrams (vol. 2, 1944, p. 475), Mimosaceae: small regular mostly perfect flowers, in heads; Calliandra: stamens numerous, long-exserted, filaments united below into a tube. Kearney and Peebles (1942, pp. 412-413) for Calliandra: stamens very numerous.

traits.stamens.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as the floras read give words, not counts: Abrams (vol. 2, 1944, p. 475) 'stamens numerous', Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 412) 'stamens very numerous'; 20 to 60 is the usual count in the genus.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Abrams (vol. 2, 1944, p. 475), Calliandra: stamens numerous, long-exserted; C. eriophylla's corolla 4-6 mm long and its stamens about 2 cm, so they hang far out of the flower as a tassel.
